title: Chief Executive Officer
description: Chief Executive Officer hold the highest ranking in a pyramidal corporate structure. They are able to hold a complete idea of the functioning of the business, its departments, risks, and stakeholders. They analyze different kinds of information and create links among them for decision-making purposes. They serve as a communication link with the board of directors for reporting and implementation of the overall strategy.

title: Chief Operating Officer
description: Chief Operating Officer oversees a company’s business operations and reports to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO). Ensures daily operations of the company run smoothly. Chief operating officers also develop company policies, rules and goals.

title: Chief Technical Officer
description: Chief Technical Officer oversee all aspects of their company’s technology strategy, including planning for future technologies and systems, developing new products or services, maintaining existing systems, and managing relationships with outside vendors.

title: Senior Manager
description: Senior Manager  plan, direct, coordinate and evaluate overall enterprise or organisation activities, define and formulate policies and provide overall organizational direction.

title: General Manager
description: General Manager plan, direct, coordinate and evaluate overall enterprise or organisation activities, define and formulate policies and provide overall organizational direction.

title: Manager
description: Manager plan, direct, coordinate and evaluate overall enterprise or organisation activities, define and formulate policies and provide overall organizational direction.

title: Financial Controller
description: Financial Controller plan, organise and administer accounting systems, and examine and analyse the accounting and financial records of individuals and establishments to ensure accuracy and compliance with established accounting standards and procedures.

title: Accountant
description: Accountant plan, organise and administer accounting systems, and examine and analyse the accounting and financial records of individuals and establishments to ensure accuracy and compliance with established accounting standards and procedures.

title: Human Resource Manager
description: Human Resource Manager planning organizing, managing, controlling and coordinating personnel Management corporate relationships, occupational safety and health, planning and operating procedures for staff recruitment, Trainingpromotion, conversion and dismissal of staff and planning and arranging negotiations and procedures for determining the structure and level of employment and consult with employees on terms of employment. Responsible for plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate policies concerning the personnel, industrial relations and occupational safety and health of an enterprise or organisation, or of enterprises that provide human resource services to other enterprises and organisations.

title: Training Specialist
description: Training Specialist provide professional business services related to personnel policies such as employee recruitment or development, occupational analyses and vocational guidance.

title: Human Resource Expert
description: Human Resource Expert Human Resource Expert develop and implement strategies that help their employers select and retain appropriately qualified staff within that business sector. They recruit staff, prepare job advertisements, interview and short-list people, negotiate with employment agencies, and set up working conditions.

title: Chief Information Officer
description: Chief Information Officer create and direct strategic information technology long-term goals, policies and procedures. Determine the organization's long-term system requirements and the acquisition of the hardware needed to achieve organizational business objectives. Provide technical guidance on projects and direct the company to grow in the information technology industry.

title: Information Technology Project Manager
description: Information Technology Project Manager develops, maintains, and revises proposals for assigned information technology (IT) projects including project objectives, technologies, systems, information specifications, timelines, funding, and staffing.

title: Information Systems Manager
description: Information Systems Manager responsible for the secure and effective operation of all computer systems, related applications, hardware and software that is used within a wide range of public and private sector organisations.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Full Stack Developer developing and designing front end web architecture, ensuring the responsiveness of applications, and working alongside graphic designers for web design features.

title: Website Developer
description: Website Developer combine design and technical knowledge to study, analyse, evaluate, design, programme and modify websites and applications that display text, graphics, animation, imaging, audio and video, and other interactive media.

title: Systems Tester
description: Systems Tester develop and execute software tests to identify software problems and their causes and participate in software design reviews to provide input on functional requirements, operational characteristics, product designs, and schedules.

title: Software Programmer
description: Software Programmer write and maintain programmable code outlined in technical instructions and specifications for software applications and operating systems.

title: Information Security Officer
description: Information Security Officer plan, implement, upgrade, or monitor security measures for the protection of computer networks and information. Assess system vulnerabilities for security risks and propose and implement risk mitigation strategies. May ensure appropriate security controls are in place that will safeguard digital files and vital electronic infrastructure. May respond to computer security breaches and viruses.

title: Database Administrator
description: Database Administrator design, develop, control, maintain and support the optimal performance and security of databases.

title: Computer Support Engineer
description: Computer Support Engineer research, design, develop, and train artificial intelligence algorithms and machine learning primitives that understand the content of digital images based on a large amount of data. They apply this understanding to solve different real-world problems such as security, autonomous driving, robotic manufacturing, digital image classification, medical image processing and diagnosis, etc.

title: Information Technology Executive
description: Information Technology Executive responsible for overseeing the overall IT strategy, direction, and management within an organization. This role involves both strategic and operational responsibilities, and IT Executives play a crucial role in aligning technology initiatives with business goals.

title: Network Analyst
description: Network Analyst research, analyse and recommend strategies for network architecture and development. They implement, manage, maintain and configure network hardware and software, and monitor, troubleshoot and optimise performance.

title: Production Supervisor
description: Production Supervisor coordinate, plan and direct manufacturing and production processes. They are responsible for reviewing production schedules or orders as well as dealing with staff in these production areas.

title: Computer Technician
description: A Computer Technician is a professional who is tasked with maintaining computer systems, troubleshooting errors, and repairing the organization's hardware.

title: Machine Operator
description: Machine Operator operate and monitor equipment which finishes, plates and coats metal articles or parts in order to give them improved resistance to corrosion and abrasion, for decorative purposes, or to impart electrical or magnetic properties.

title: Line Leader
description: Line Leader oversee manufacturing activities within their departments. They manage production assembly lines, assist their teams to complete orders, and prepare reports. They may be employed in various settings, ranging from factories and warehouses to production facilities.

title: Factory Hand
description: Factory Hand perform to assist machine operators and product assemblers. They clean the machines and the working areas. Make sure supplies and materials are replenished.

title: Operator, Truck Forklift
description: Operator, Truck Forklift drive, responsible for operating forklifts to move, locate, relocate, stack, and count merchandise. They are accountable for the safe and efﬁcient operation of forklifts. Moreover, they perform the filling of orders and check the accuracy of other orders.

title: General Administrative Assistant
description: General Administrative Assistant provide high-level administrative support by conducting research, preparing statistical reports, and handling information requests, as well as performing routine administrative functions such as preparing correspondence, receiving visitors, arranging conference calls, and scheduling meetings. May also train and supervise lower-level clerical staff.

title: Administrative Assistant (Secretarial) Grade 21
description: Administrative Assistant (Secretarial) Grade 21 responsible for ensuring that the daily affairs in the office of the top management group officers are handled efficiently and with high quality as well as regulating the work schedule in an orderly manner. Perform tasks such as typing, preparing correspondence, reports and file management.
